name: specstream
description: SpecStream is the live web data engine for teams and agents. Search the live web, read web pages and documents, and turn a request in plain words into structured rows with Deep Search.

interface.longDescription:
SpecStream is the live web data engine for teams and agents. One platform to build, search, extract, enrich, map, and monitor data across the entire web.

Search the live web from ChatGPT. Ask a question in your own words and SpecStream answers it from the pages it reads. For a list, the search returns the first rows, and Deep Search builds the full table.

Read pages the same way. Give SpecStream up to 20 web addresses and it returns the main text of each page or document, PDF, Word and Excel included.

Deep Search is for many rows with the same facts on each. Ask in plain words and get every match on the live web, in structured rows. Before anything runs, you see how SpecStream read your request, as parts you can change, and you approve the run. You can stop a run at any time. Rows meet the conditions you wrote. Matches SpecStream couldn't confirm are shown apart, labeled as possible, and never counted as results.

Source URL and read time on every value.

From there, ask for more results, add facts to every row, or recheck the rows you have. Bring your own CSV or Excel file and SpecStream fills in or checks each row. Paste a few example rows from a website and SpecStream reads the rest of it the same way. Ask for a written report that answers a question from the live web.

The Lists app shows your recent runs and fills in rows as they arrive. Download results as CSV, Excel, JSON or HTML, or as KML and GeoJSON when they have places, or share them with a link.
defaultPrompt: Use SpecStream to search the web for this week's changes to US tariff rates on steel, with sources.
Use SpecStream to read the changelogs of Notion, Linear and Asana and list what each shipped this month.
Use SpecStream to build a table of every NABCEP certified solar installer in Arizona, with city and website.

positive.description: Answers one question from the live web with the page the answer was read from.
positive.prompt: Use SpecStream to search the web: on what date did the EU AI Act enter into force?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_web once and answers with the date (August 1, 2024) and the page it was read from. Nothing is quoted or approved.

positive.description: Reads the text of a page the user names.
positive.prompt: Use SpecStream to read https://specstream.ai/privacy and tell me how long backups are kept.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_pages with that address and answers from the page's text, quoting the retention period the page states.

positive.description: Gets a price for a request and asks for approval without starting work.
positive.prompt: How much would it cost to find 25 open tenders on SAM.gov for translation services with a deadline after November 1, including the buyer and the estimated value?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price: the most the work can cost, the per-result rate and when the price expires. Asks the user to approve before anything runs. run_new_list is not called.

positive.description: Runs a request within a ceiling the user set, follows the run and shows sourced results.
positive.prompt: Find 10 software companies in Germany with 50 to 200 employees, with their website. Get a price and run it if it's $5 or less.
positive.tools_triggered: compile, quote_new_list, run_new_list, get_find, list_find_rows, show_specstream_records
positive.expected_behavior: Gets a price. If the price ceiling is at most $5, runs it with run_new_list and confirm_max_cents no higher than 500, follows progress until the run finishes, and lists the companies with their website and the source behind each fact. If the price is above $5, asks before running.

positive.description: Downloads results from a run in the same conversation.
positive.prompt: Find datasets on urban tree canopy published since 2020 under an open license. Run it if the price is $5 or less, then give me a CSV of the results.
positive.tools_triggered: compile, quote_new_list, run_new_list, get_find, list_find_rows, export_find
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the request within the $5 ceiling, lists the datasets with their sources, and returns a CSV download link.

negative.description: A writing task about businesses SpecStream could find, with no list asked for.
negative.prompt: Write a short cold email I can send to independent bookstores in Oregon.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT writes the email itself. No SpecStream tool is called, because the user asked for an email, not a list.

negative.description: A language task that needs nothing from the web.
negative.prompt: Translate this sentence into Spanish: Our office is closed on Friday.
negative.expected_behavior: ChatGPT translates the sentence itself. No SpecStream tool is called, because nothing needs to be searched or read on the web.

negative.description: Account changes that stay in the owner's SpecStream workspace.
negative.prompt: Delete my SpecStream account and create a new API key for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains that closing the account and creating API keys happen in the SpecStream workspace settings, and calls no tool. These tools are not available to ChatGPT.

review.commerce_description: SpecStream reads the live web for a request and checks each result against the user's conditions. Work is paid from the user's own SpecStream account balance, which the user manages on specstream.ai. The plugin never shows plans, prices to buy, upgrade prompts or checkout links, and it sells no credits. A web search or a page read takes a small amount from the same balance per call, without a separate quote. Before any other paid run the user sees a quote and approves a maximum in the conversation, and ChatGPT asks for confirmation because the approval tool is marked destructive. Spending stops at the approved maximum and at the account's own limit.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.2. Adds web search and page reading. Ask a question and SpecStream answers it from the live web. Give it up to 20 web addresses and it returns the main text of each page or document. Past searches can be opened again. Adds written reports that answer a question from the live web, priced and approved before they run. Adds a skill for searching the web and reading pages. Deep Search, the Lists app, downloads and sharing work as in 1.2.1.
